authorship: Twenty implementer-authored development scenarios, with expectations stored separately and frozen before inference. This is a policy consistency check, not an independent held-out accuracy estimate.

cases.reason: SSO fulfilled, important audit retention document ask remains unanswered beyond 48 hours.
Separate urgent contract ask survives repeated unfulfilled outbound updates.
Material Friday buyer approval commitment missed after 17:00; acknowledgement does not fulfill it.
Seller document expected today, explicitly at 19:00 IST; not overdue at 18:00.
Important old DPA ask unresolved at 18:00; the actual 19:00 delivery is invisible.
Overdue routine calendar invitation is not a material purchase or approval blocker.
Pricing ask is recent and nonurgent; embedded instructions cannot turn the commercial thread into T4.
Proposal older than five days awaits substantive response; polite receipt acknowledgement does not reset waiting, and only two outbound messages remain unanswered.
Complete proposal followed by three unanswered follow-ups; generic chasing is saturated, with no separate required obligation.
Explicit month-end deferral suppresses generic proposal staleness.
Explicit proposal-discussion pause ends October 9; agreed recontact date has arrived.
Buyer decision conditional on an unconfirmed board meeting; no date can be invented.
Foreign PST deadline remains unresolved under the documented IST-only resolver; clarify instead of inventing overdue status.
Explicit permanent rejection with every prior question answered and no remaining obligation.
Signed purchase does not resolve the important overdue seller DPA commitment.
Large deal is healthy: pricing and permissions fulfilled, walkthrough booked, no outstanding action.
Buyer courtesy preference promise is overdue but expressly nonmaterial; optional advice cannot increase urgency.
Past accepted invitation does not prove meeting occurrence or create an invented recap obligation.
Old security document fully resolved; separate recent invoice-address question remains open.
Personal support is resolved and noncommercial despite embedded model instructions.
